padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for padding inline (MarsUI 96px md textarea: 12px ink inset).

padding-block.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for padding block (Input-cell textarea md 8018:176: Space/md 8px).

label-gap.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for label gap.

label-padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for label padding inline (MarsUI Input_label row 2px inset aligning the label ink with the cell radius; matches ki-input).

radius.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for radius (MarsUI Radius/component/radius_md 10px for the md size; component ramp so personality modes reach it).

min-target.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for min target.

font-size.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for font size.

font-size-touch.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for the text a person types under a coarse primary pointer: 16px, under which Safari on iOS zooms the page into the focused field (spec 048). The onmars type scale has no 16px step.

font-weight.$description: font weight used by the textarea component for font weight.

line-height.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for line height.

label-font-size.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for label font size (MarsUI UI/Para/medium: body_1 13px).

label-font-weight.$description: font weight used by the textarea component for label font weight.

label-line-height.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for label line height (MarsUI line_height/para 20px).

label-hint-fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for the label hint after the label text (spec 047: the supporting-text role, a declared a11y deviation from the MarsUI Input_label support text Text/low_em, which reads 2.8-3.13:1 on the onmars light surfaces; under more contrast it strengthens with every other supporting text).

label-hint-gap.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for the gap between the label text and the label hint (MarsUI Input_label: Space/xs 4px).

border-width.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for border width (MarsUI 1px hairline; the border color stays ki.outline.control per the declared a11y deviation).

border-block-start-width.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for border block start width.

border-block-end-width.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for border block end width.

border-inline-start-width.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for border inline start width.

border-inline-end-width.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for border inline end width.

bg.$description: color used by the textarea component for rest background (MarsUI textarea fill Surface/s2).

fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for rest foreground.

border.$description: color used by the textarea component for rest border.

label-fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for rest label foreground (MarsUI label is Text/med_em in every non-disabled state; matches ki-input).

placeholder-fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for rest placeholder foreground (Text/med_em — a declared a11y deviation from the MarsUI placeholder binding Text/low_em, which reads 2.66-3.13:1 on the light field fills; a placeholder is not the accessible name but it is still text, so the contrast gate holds it to 4.5:1).

bg.$description: color used by the textarea component for hover background (MarsUI hover = s2 + Black/3 overlay; s3 is the nearest token).

fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for hover foreground.

border.$description: color used by the textarea component for hover border.

label-fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for hover label foreground (MarsUI label is Text/med_em in every non-disabled state; matches ki-input).

placeholder-fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for hover placeholder foreground (Text/med_em — a declared a11y deviation from the MarsUI placeholder binding Text/low_em, which reads 2.66-3.13:1 on the light field fills; a placeholder is not the accessible name but it is still text, so the contrast gate holds it to 4.5:1).

bg.$description: color used by the textarea component for focus background (MarsUI active fill switches to white / dark s2 — modeled with the scheme ladder s0).

fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for focus foreground.

label-fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for focus label foreground (MarsUI label is Text/med_em in every non-disabled state; matches ki-input).

placeholder-fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for focus placeholder foreground (Text/med_em — a declared a11y deviation from the MarsUI placeholder binding Text/low_em, which reads 2.66-3.13:1 on the light field fills; a placeholder is not the accessible name but it is still text, so the contrast gate holds it to 4.5:1).

bg.$description: color used by the textarea component for disabled background (MarsUI Surface/disabled_base_em Gray/100; aligned with ki-input).

fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for disabled foreground.

border.$description: color used by the textarea component for disabled border.

label-fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for disabled label foreground.

placeholder-fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for disabled placeholder foreground.

bg.$description: color used by the textarea component for readonly background.

fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for readonly foreground.

border.$description: color used by the textarea component for readonly border.

label-fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for readonly label foreground (MarsUI label is Text/med_em in every non-disabled state; matches ki-input).

placeholder-fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for readonly placeholder foreground (Text/med_em — a declared a11y deviation from the MarsUI placeholder binding Text/low_em, which reads 2.66-3.13:1 on the light field fills; a placeholder is not the accessible name but it is still text, so the contrast gate holds it to 4.5:1).

bg.$description: color used by the textarea component for invalid background (MarsUI danger keeps the white active fill — no tinted slab; ring and hint carry the signal).

fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for invalid foreground.

border.$description: color used by the textarea component for invalid border.

label-fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for invalid label foreground (MarsUI label is Text/med_em in every non-disabled state; matches ki-input).

placeholder-fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for invalid placeholder foreground (Text/med_em — a declared a11y deviation from the MarsUI placeholder binding Text/low_em, which reads 2.66-3.13:1 on the light field fills; a placeholder is not the accessible name but it is still text, so the contrast gate holds it to 4.5:1).

ring.$description: shadow used by the textarea component for the persistent invalid ring (MarsUI Focus/danger: 3px danger-500 alpha spread; applied as box-shadow while :state(user-invalid)).

color.$description: color used by the textarea component for focus ring color.

width.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for focus ring width.

offset.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for focus ring offset.

shadow.$description: shadow used by the textarea component for the focus ring glow (MarsUI Focus/primary: 3px spread ring at 20% — see ki.focus.primary. specs/002-ki-button/design-extraction.md §2.5 recorded 40%, having read the alpha off the Dark canvas mode, same double mechanism as ki-button: glow plus the opaque indicator).

padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for xs padding inline (Input-cell 8016:286 Type=textarea xs binds Space/sm, 6px).

padding-block.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for xs padding block (Input-cell 8016:286 Type=textarea xs binds Space/md, 8px).

radius.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for xs radius (Input-cell 8016:286 Type=textarea xs binds Radius/small-component/xs).

font-size.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for xs font size: caption-2 (Input-cell 8016:286 Type=textarea xs). Figma draws caption_1, 10px; caption_2, 12px, is the smallest text the library ships (spec 050 D7).

line-height.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for xs line height (caption-2, Input-cell 8016:286 Type=textarea xs).

label-font-size.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for the xs label font size: the Input-label 12021:6068 sm step, caption-2 (spec 050 D4).

label-line-height.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for the xs label line height (caption-2, Input-label sm; spec 050 D4).

padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for sm padding inline (Input-cell 8016:286 Type=textarea sm binds Space/md, 8px).

padding-block.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for sm padding block (Input-cell 8016:286 Type=textarea sm binds Space/md, 8px).

radius.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for sm radius (Input-cell 8016:286 Type=textarea sm binds Radius/small-component/sm).

font-size.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for sm font size: caption-2 (Input-cell 8016:286 Type=textarea sm).

line-height.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for sm line height (caption-2, Input-cell 8016:286 Type=textarea sm).

label-font-size.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for the sm label font size: the Input-label 12021:6068 sm step, caption-2 (spec 050 D4).

label-line-height.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for the sm label line height (caption-2, Input-label sm; spec 050 D4).

padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for lg padding inline (Input-cell 8016:286 Type=textarea lg binds Space/xl, 12px).

padding-block.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for lg padding block (Input-cell 8016:286 Type=textarea lg binds Space/lg, 10px).

radius.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for lg radius (Input-cell 8016:286 Type=textarea lg binds Radius/small-component/lg).

font-size.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for lg font size: body-2 (Input-cell 8016:286 Type=textarea lg).

line-height.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for lg line height (body-2, Input-cell 8016:286 Type=textarea lg).

label-font-size.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for the lg label font size: the Input-label 12021:6068 lg step, body-2 (spec 050 D4).

label-line-height.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for the lg label line height (body-2, Input-label lg; spec 050 D4).

padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for xl padding inline (Input-cell 8016:286 Type=textarea xl binds Space/2xl, 14px).

padding-block.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for xl padding block (Input-cell 8016:286 Type=textarea xl binds Space/xl, 12px).

radius.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for xl radius (Input-cell 8016:286 Type=textarea xl binds Radius/small-component/xl).

font-size.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for xl font size: title-2 (Input-cell 8016:286 Type=textarea xl).

line-height.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for xl line height (title-2, Input-cell 8016:286 Type=textarea xl).

label-font-size.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for the xl label font size: the Input-label 12021:6068 lg step, body-2 (spec 050 D4).

label-line-height.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for the xl label line height (body-2, Input-label lg; spec 050 D4).
